description: Test suite for heartbeat policy functions in the cron module, verifying behavior of functions shouldSkipHeartbeatOnlyDelivery and shouldEnqueueCronMainSummary.

methods.name: shouldSkipHeartbeatOnlyDelivery
methods.description: Determines if heartbeat-only messages should be skipped based on payload content and timing.

methods.name: shouldEnqueueCronMainSummary
methods.description: Determines if the cron main summary should be enqueued based on system event and delivery status.

calls: expect(shouldSkipHeartbeatOnlyDelivery([{ text: "Checked inbox and calendar." }, { text: "HEARTBEAT_OK" }], 300)).toBe(true)

expect(shouldEnqueueCronMainSummary({summaryText: "HEARTBEAT_OK", deliveryRequested: true, delivered: false, deliveryAttempted: false, suppressMainSummary: false, isCronSystemEvent: isSystemEvent})).toBe(true)

expect(shouldEnqueueCronMainSummary({summaryText: "HEARTBEAT_OK", deliveryRequested: true, delivered: false, deliveryAttempted: true,.suppressMainSummary: false, isCronSystemEvent: isSystemEvent})).toBe(false)
